params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} Scoring an enemy champion {{tip|takedown}} will spawn a ''Mist Wraith'' for a period. {{ci|Viego}} can consume the ''Mist Wraith'' to briefly become {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|blink}} to it, which {{tip|heals}} him for a portion of the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}} and grants ''Possession''.
params.blurb2: Casting ''{{ai|Heartbreaker|Viego}}'' or consuming a ''Mist Wraith'' will end ''Possession'' early.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|Possession:}} For a period, '''Viego's''' items, stats, basic attacks, and basic abilities become those of the slain enemy's. He also gains a free cast of ''{{ai|Heartbreaker|Viego}}'' and {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing an enemy champion.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Viego''' scores an enemy champion {{tip|takedown}} while alive and within 3 seconds of damaging them, a ''Mist Wraith'' spawns from that champion's corpse for 8 seconds. '''Viego''' can basic attack a ''Mist Wraith'' to consume it: causing him to {{tip|blink}} to its location after winding up for 1 second, during which he is {{tip|untargetable}} (except to {{tip|turrets}}) and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}}. He then gains ''Possession'' and {{tip|heals}} himself for {{as|2%|health}} {{as|(+ {{fd|2.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.4}}% per 100 '''bonus''' health)}} {{as|(+ 5% per 100% '''bonus''' attack speed)}} {{as|of the target's '''maximum''' health}}.
params.description2: {{sbc|Possession:}} For 10 seconds, '''Viego''' assumes the enemy champion's form and gains their {{tip|basic attacks}}, {{tip|abilities|basic abilities}}, [[item]]s (excluding [[trinket item]]s), and base [[champion statistic|stats]] (based on '''Viego's''' [[Experience (champion)|level]]). He also gains a free cast of ''{{ai|Heartbreaker|Viego}}'', which is initially placed on a {{sti|cd|{{fd|1.5}}-second}} cooldown, and {{sti|{{as|10% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing enemy champions within 2500 units.
params.description3: '''Viego''' cannot use the possessed champion's [[Active ability items|item actives]] or [[consumable item]]s, and is unable to use the [[shop]] during ''Possession''. Casting ''{{ai|Heartbreaker|Viego}}'' or attacking a ''Mist Wraith'' ends ''Possession'' immediately.
params.description4: '''''Viego''' will preserve his {{as|'''current''' health percentage}} between transformations.''

blurb.plain: Innate: Scoring an enemy champion takedown will spawn a Mist Wraith for a period. Viego can consume the Mist Wraith to briefly become untargetable and blink to it, which heals him for a portion of the target's maximum health and grants Possession.

blurb2.plain: Casting Heartbreaker or consuming a Mist Wraith will end Possession early.

blurb4.plain: Possession: For a period, Viego's items, stats, basic attacks, and basic abilities become those of the slain enemy's. He also gains a free cast of Heartbreaker and bonus movement speed while facing an enemy champion.

description.plain: Innate: Whenever Viego scores an enemy champion takedown while alive and within 3 seconds of damaging them, a Mist Wraith spawns from that champion's corpse for 8 seconds. Viego can basic attack a Mist Wraith to consume it: causing him to blink to its location after winding up for 1 second, during which he is untargetable (except to turrets) and unable to act. He then gains Possession and heals himself for 2% (+ 2.5% per 100 bonus AD) (+ 2% per 100 AP) (+ 0.4% per 100 bonus health) (+ 5% per 100% bonus attack speed) of the target's maximum health.

description2.plain: Possession: For 10 seconds, Viego assumes the enemy champion's form and gains their basic attacks, basic abilities, items (excluding trinket items), and base stats (based on Viego's level). He also gains a free cast of Heartbreaker, which is initially placed on a 1.5-second cooldown, and 10% bonus movement speed while facing enemy champions within 2500 units.

description3.plain: Viego cannot use the possessed champion's item actives or consumable items, and is unable to use the shop during Possession. Casting Heartbreaker or attacking a Mist Wraith ends Possession immediately.

description4.plain: Viego will preserve his current health percentage between transformations.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{cis|Viego}} basic attacks deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''current''' health}}. Additionally, '''Viego's''' damaging abilities apply a mark to enemies hit. His next basic attack will consume the mark to strike twice, dealing additional {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}} and {{tip|healing}} him.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viego''' stabs in a line in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, increased based on his {{as|{{sti|critical strike chance}}}}.
params.blurb4: ''Blade of the Ruined King's'' passive remains under ''{{ai|Sovereign's Domination|Viego|Possession}}''.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Viego's''' basic attacks deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}. This damage can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|170|70}}|critical damage}} damage, has a minimum threshold and is capped at 80 against {{tip|monsters}}.
params.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|2 to 6}}% of target's '''current''' health}}|Critical Bonus Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|2*1.7 to 6*1.7}}% of target's '''current''' health}}}}
{{st|Minimum Bonus Damage|{{ap|10 to 30}}}}
params.description2: Additionally, his damaging {{tip|abilities}} apply a mark to enemies hit for 4 seconds. '''Viego's''' next basic attack against a marked target is empowered to consume the mark {{tip|on-hit}} to strike a second time, dealing {{tt|{{as|20% AD}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}}|Scales on current AD and AP}} {{as|physical damage}}. He also {{tip|heal|heals}} himself for a portion of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt by the second strike: 100% against {{tip|minions}}, 125% against monsters, and 150% against other targets.
params.description3: The second strike applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects and can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Viego|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage.
params.description4: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viego''' stabs in a line in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 60|critScaling=true}}.
params.description5: ''Blade of the Ruined King's passive remains under {{ai|Sovereign's Domination|Viego|Possession}}, and while transformed, the second strike is instead converted to '''bonus''' damage on-hit which no longer applies on-hit effects but can still {{tip|critically strike}} (based on the Possession's stats, abilities and/or item effects).''
params.range: {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|-25 - 600|Rectangle length is 625 units total, starting from 25 units behind Viego's center}}
params.cast time: {{as|{{ap|1.4*100}}% of '''Viego's''' windup time|as}} ({{ap|1.4*(1/{{ccd|Viego|as_base}})*{{ccd|Viego|windup}}|round=3}} at {{as|'''base''' attack speed}})
params.notes:
* ''Blade of the Ruined King'' deals:
** {{Tip|Area damage}} for the thrust.
** {{Tip|Basic damage}} for the second strike.
** {{Tip|Proc damage}} for the on-hit bonus damage.
* Ability damage that applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects (''e.g.'', {{ais|R|Viego}} damage against the primary target) cannot apply the mark but can consume it, as a basic attack would.
* The second strike rolls {{tip|critical strikes}} independently from the primary attack.
* This ability's cast time respects the attack speed [[Attack speed|floor and cap]].
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* '''Viego''' will not perform the second strike if the first attack was {{tip|dodge|dodged}}, {{tip|blocked|blocked}}, and {{tip|blind|missed}}.
* If the second strike hits a dead unit, '''Viego''' will still {{tip|heal}} based on the post-mitigation damage that he would deal with it.
* The attacks do not deal the '''bonus''' damage against {{tip|structures}}.
* The mark does not cause '''Viego''' to attack twice. Effects that trigger {{tip|on-attack}} or interact with the attack windup will only trigger once and thus do not interact with ''Blade of the Ruined King''. (e.g. {{ri|Lethal Tempo}}, {{ri|Hail of Blades}}).
params.tips:
* ''Blade of the Ruined King's'' cast time at a given basic attack timer can be calculated as: [{{#expr:1.4*(0.3+{{ccd|Viego|attack_delay_offset}})round3}} ÷ {{as|'''total''' attack speed|attack speed}}] (in seconds).
** The cast time equals {{rutngt|0.25}} (which is the standard for most abilities in ''League of Legends'') at approximately {{as|{{fd|32.6}}% '''bonus''' attack speed|attack speed}} (as of [[V25.07]]).

blurb.plain: Active: Viego charges up to a short time to increase the range and stun of his blast. Spectral Maw can be recast within the duration and automatically cancels afterwards.

blurb2.plain: Recast: Viego dashes in the target direction, hurling a blast of mist that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit and briefly stuns them based on charge time.

description.plain: Active: Viego charges while being slowed by 10% for up to 3 seconds to increase Spectral Maw's missile range and stun duration over the first second of the channel.

description4.plain: Spectral Maw resets Viego's basic attack timer. Viego can cast any of his abilities during the dash.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Viego}} sends a spectre in the target direction that creates a trail of mist in its wake for a period. If it hits [[terrain]], the mist is spread further around either side.
params.blurb2: While inside the mist, '''Viego''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}. If he does not attack or cast abilities, he also gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and {{tip|camouflage}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viego''' sends a spectre in the target direction that creates a trail of mist in its wake which lasts 8 seconds. If it hits [[terrain]], the mist will spread further around either side.
params.description2: While inside the mist, '''Viego''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}. If he does not attack or cast abilities, he also gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and {{tip|camouflage}}.
params.leveling2:
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|30 to 50}}%}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|25 to 35}}% {{as|(+ 4% per 100 AP)}}}}
params.description3: Declaring a basic attack or casting an ability will break the camouflage and remove the {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}, preventing '''Viego''' from gaining them again for 1 second, increased to 2 seconds if he attacked a large {{tip|monster}}. This duration refreshes on subsequent attacks and ability casts.
params.description4: ''Harrowed Path can be cast during any of '''Viego's''' abilities. '''Viego''' cannot gain the camouflage nor {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} from Harrowed Path for 1 second if he casts it during {{ais|Spectral Maw|Viego}} channel or starts the channel while the mist was active.''

params.notes:
* {{ais|Spectral Maw|Viego}} recast does not incur the 1 second cooldown for regaining the stealth and instead prevents the stealth from being gained until the dash ends, resetting the cooldown if it is active.
** The cooldown is not reset if it was incurred by basic attacking a large monster, but is however reset from it being incurred by {{ais|Spectral Maw|Viego}} channel.
* The bonus movement speed and camouflage are granted by the same buff, called [[File: Harrowed Path 2.png|20px|link=]] ''Lord of the Mist''.
* '''Viego''' will enter camouflage even while {{si|Recall|Recalling}}.
* '''Viego''' can cast ''Harrowed Path'' during the cast time of any ability or spell.
* ''Harrowed Path'' will follow '''Viego''' into {{cai|Realm of Death|Mordekaiser|Death Realm}}.
* Ranking up ''Harrowed Path'' while the effect is already active will still immediately improve the bonuses it grants.
* The initial missile can be destroyed by {{tip|projectile}}-blocking effects, but the formed Black Mist trail will not disappear. The wall spread missiles cannot be destroyed.
* ''Harrowed Path'' can interact with [[Terrain#Player-Generated|player-generated terrain]].
** The spread path around terrain is determined upon collision and does not change even if the terrain expires mid-spread.
** {{Pending for test}} Terrain being created while ''Harrowed Path'' is spreading.
* Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the start of the attack windup.
** The stealth regain timer is refreshed from basic attacks at the start of their attack windup.
* '''Viego''' can benefit from an enemy's ''Harrowed Path'', gaining the bonus stats corresponding to his own ''Harrowed Path''.
params.tips: * ''Harrowed Path'' will grant the {{tip|camouflage}} immediately if cast during {{ai|Spectral Maw|Viego}} or {{ai|Heartbreaker|Viego}}.

blurb.plain: Active: Viego sends a spectre in the target direction that creates a trail of mist in its wake for a period. If it hits terrain, the mist is spread further around either side.

blurb2.plain: While inside the mist, Viego gains bonus attack speed. If he does not attack or cast abilities, he also gains bonus movement speed and camouflage.

description.plain: Active: Viego sends a spectre in the target direction that creates a trail of mist in its wake which lasts 8 seconds. If it hits terrain, the mist will spread further around either side.

description2.plain: While inside the mist, Viego gains bonus attack speed. If he does not attack or cast abilities, he also gains bonus movement speed and camouflage.

description3.plain: Declaring a basic attack or casting an ability will break the camouflage and remove the bonus movement speed, preventing Viego from gaining them again for 1 second, increased to 2 seconds if he attacked a large monster. This duration refreshes on subsequent attacks and ability casts.

description4.plain: Harrowed Path can be cast during any of Viego's abilities. Viego cannot gain the camouflage nor bonus movement speed from Harrowed Path for 1 second if he casts it during Spectral Maw channel or starts the channel while the mist was active.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Viego}} {{tip|blinks}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} to the target location, dealing {{as|physical damage}} based on his {{as|{{sti|critical strike chance}}}} to all nearby enemies upon arrival.
params.blurb2: The most wounded enemy champion hit takes {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} based on {{as|their '''missing''' health}}, is dealt {{tip|on-hit}} effects, and is {{tip|slow|slowed}} briefly. Other enemies hit are {{tip|airborne|knocked back}}.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|{{tip|displacement immunity|nolink=true}}:}} The blink cannot be deterred by {{tip|crowd control}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viego''' gains {{tip|displacement immunity}} over the cast time, then {{tip|blink|blinks}} to the target location. Upon arrival, he strikes the {{tt|most wounded|Lowest health percent}} enemy champion {{tt|nearby|Alternatively the closest one if all targets have the same percent health}}, dealing {{as|physical damage}}, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 99% for {{fd|0.25}} seconds, and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects. Other nearby enemies are {{tip|airborne|knocked back}} up to 400-units away based on proximity, though not through terrain.
params.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|12 to 20}}% {{as|(+ 5% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''missing''' health}}}}
params.description2: All targets hit are dealt {{as|120% AD}} {{as|physical damage}}, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 70|critScaling=true}}.
params.description3: ''If a {{ai|Sovereign's Domination|Viego|Possession}} is discarded, Heartbreaker will be placed on a {{sti|cd|{{fd|1.5}}-second}} cooldown if it is not already on cooldown.''
params.notes:
* ''Heartbreaker'' will cast at the edge of its range if the target location is further beyond.
* ''Heartbreaker'' will cast at maximum range from the end of {{ais|Spectral Maw|Viego}} dash if it is cast during the dash.
* The knockback speed is 1000 units per second. The airborne is removed as soon as the displacement ends.
** The maximum airborne duration is therefore {{fd|0.4}} seconds. The minimum is {{fd|0.1}} seconds.
* To the struck champion deals {{tip|basic damage}}, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}; to all other enemies, deals {{tip|area damage}}.
* '''Viego''' will enter a {{fd|0.25}}-second [[cast time]] if he strikes an enemy champion.
** After this cast time, he will automatically receive an attack command against that enemy. Previous movement inputs from the player are ignored.{{bug|1}}
* ''Heartbreaker's'' strike to the champion can be {{tip|dodge|dodged}} and {{tip|block|blocked}}, but not {{tip|blind|missed}}.
* '''Viego''' will be ordered to [[basic attack]] the primary target afterwards.

blurb.plain: Active: Viego blinks with displacement immunity to the target location, dealing physical damage based on his critical strike chance to all nearby enemies upon arrival.

blurb2.plain: The most wounded enemy champion hit takes bonus physical damage based on their missing health, is dealt on-hit effects, and is slowed briefly. Other enemies hit are knocked back.

blurb4.plain: displacement immunity: The blink cannot be deterred by crowd control.

description.plain: Active: Viego gains displacement immunity over the cast time, then blinks to the target location. Upon arrival, he strikes the most wounded enemy champion nearby, dealing physical damage, slowing them by 99% for 0.25 seconds, and applying on-hit effects. Other nearby enemies are knocked back up to 400-units away based on proximity, though not through terrain.

description2.plain: All targets hit are dealt 120% AD physical damage, increased by ⟦critical damage⟧.

description3.plain: If a Sovereign's Domination is discarded, Heartbreaker will be placed on a 1.5-second cooldown if it is not already on cooldown.
